sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT customer_id, tenant_id, SUM(total_cents) AS s FROM shop_orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id, tenant_id) SELECT v.id, v.name, p.s FROM shop_live_customers_v v JOIN paid p ON p.customer_id = v.id AND p.tenant_id = v.tenant_id WHERE v.tenant_id = 1
description: pre-aggregates in a CTE and reads the live view
